description: Give the final OK on one report a pro sent to a pro ask: the verifier records it and the pro is paid from what the ask holds. Approval is final. Call without confirm first: it says the report, who sent it, what approving pays and whose OK it is; then again with confirm: true, which approves when this key is the one the ask names to give the OK. When the OK is the person's own (a pro ask posted for them), it hands them the report's Approve button on the site instead, and sends nothing.

claimId.description: The report's id: the claim my_pro_asks or the ask's page names.

collectionId.description: The pro ask's number (my_pro_asks shows it).

confirm.description: Leave out to see what approving pays and whose OK it is. true approves.

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).

name: approve_report
title: Approve a report on a pro ask (spends money)
